title: Asset and Contact
author: Odile Hartwell
blurb: Juniper Ishikawa, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
